facts.text: Parkville was named after Royal Park, the largest inner‑city park in Melbourne, which also hosts the Royal Melbourne Zoological Gardens.
The 2006 Commonwealth Games athlete's village was built on the former Royal Park Psychiatric Hospital site, now the residential Parkville Gardens.
South Parkville became Australia’s first classified metropolitan area, a status later cemented by its inclusion in the State Historic Register.
Parkville railway station, built under Grattan Street, opened in late 2025 as part of Melbourne’s Metro Rail Project.
Parkville borders North Melbourne, Carlton, Brunswick, and Flemington, placing it just north of Melbourne’s city centre.
The University of Melbourne, erected in 1853, was the first major institution built in what is now Parkville.
